title: PAR-134/7Q VIEWPORT ambient CMC method retention
scope: Audit a scalar/RGB CMC consumer whose public model already contains a method field
Reproduce loss of the CMC method through the production VIEWPORT parser
Retain the parsed method without changing scalar projection or writer behavior

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: The R2007+ VIEWPORT ambient-light field is CMC; CMC carries its color method in the packed BL.

localSource.finding: DRW_Viewport::parseDwg requested scalar, RGB, and optional names from getCmColor but not its existing outMethod result. The existing ambientColorMethod field remained at reset value 0 for all decoded colors. The parser now retains the method in that pre-existing field.
localSource.limit: This changes no encoder behavior and does not establish the packed payload of a real producer.

generatedControls.finding: Generated VIEWPORT frames cover C0 ByLayer, C1 ByBlock, C3 ACI, and C2 RGB. Each asserts the retained method plus existing scalar/RGB projection and verifies the following handle sentinel remains aligned.
generatedControls.baseline: Before the parser change, all four method-field assertions failed while frames parsed successfully.
generatedControls.limit: Frames are locally generated through the production encoder/parser; they are not producer-authored samples.

productionSummary: Pass the existing getCmColor outMethod destination from DRW_Viewport::parseDwg.
Store the decoded method in the existing ambientColorMethod field after bounded CMC parse succeeds.
generatedTestSummary: Add generated AC1024 VIEWPORT frame builder and C0-C3 method/scalar/RGB assertions.
Add following-handle alignment sentinel and focused --viewport-ambient-color-method selector.

assessment.confirmedLocalResult: Generated AC1024 VIEWPORT parsing retains the CMC method for ByLayer, ByBlock, ACI, and RGB while preserving the existing scalar/RGB values and following-handle alignment.
unresolved: The wider scalar-only CMC consumer audit remains open.
HATCH/MPOLYGON C5 payload and producer behavior remain unqualified.
C4 and C6-C8 remain unsupported for third-party semantic projection; no generic fallback policy is promoted.
DRW_Light::parseDwg also requests only scalar CMC output; its DWG RGB retention and the exact class-specific DXF color mapping remain to be audited.
The associative-action dwgResbufValueKind payload layout still requires its exact ODA consumer field description.
Independent semantic and native/platform qualification remain separate gates.
assessment.nextAction: Add a generated C2 DRW_Light parser control, retain RGB in the DWG model/encoder if confirmed, and establish the class-specific DXF color contract before changing its writer; separately seek the exact ODA field layout for associative-action value kinds.
